name: How long does it take to hang drywall in a typical remodel?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to hang drywall in a typical remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to hang drywall depends on room square footage, ceiling heights, and layout complexity. For an average residential room or basement section, hanging the drywall panels typically takes one to two days for a skilled crew. However, complex architectural features like custom soffits, tray ceilings, archways, and window returns require precise measuring and cutouts that extend hanging time. After the sheets are fastened, joint compound drying and sanding add several more days before the area is ready for finish carpentry or paint.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hanging drywall in a standard room or basement generally takes one to two days, though detailed cuts, tall ceilings, and archways add extra time.
